needs.what: a static that grants the encore activated ability to cards in its controller's graveyard matching a filter (artifact creature cards), with the encore cost set to each card's own printed mana cost; activation exiles the card from the graveyard as a cost, is sorcery-speed only, and for each opponent creates a token copy of the exiled card that has haste, must attack that opponent this turn if able, and is sacrificed at the beginning of the next end step
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The grant_ability static hands over an ability only to permanents on the battlefield (the packet notes say a granted activated ability works on the battlefield only), and there is no grants_encore analogue to grants_flashback/grants_retrace; grant_warp and granted_alternative_cost grant cast permissions, not an activated graveyard ability; nor is there a cost or value meaning 'this card's own mana cost' for a granted ability. The resolution half (copy_permanent with attacking per for_each_player, haste, delayed sacrifice) might be composable, but nothing can put the ability on the graveyard card
